""@LuvRaces
Please consider the influence on the other Umamusume.
This is way too irresponsible.""
Summer training camp had begun once again this year, but—
Fenomeno gripped her smartphone tightly, a bitter look on her face.
choice_data_list: Are you looking at social media again?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I couldn't help myself.
Still, the more I look at them,
these people are truly—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I started to think
that they might be just like I used to be.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've spent quite a long time
with Golshi-san up until now, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san truly is
'an Umamusume who should NOT be imitated'!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: However, "not to be imitated" isn't the only thing that defines her essence!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I absolutely, categorically cannot
forgive any part of this that is unacceptable!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is not one's very existence that should be
flatly rejected, but rather
their actions.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is also true that having her around
kept me motivated and driven.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is also true that, thanks to her,
there was a young boy who was able to spend
every day smiling.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Encounters serve as the catalyst for a person to grow.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Because existence itself is what gives birth to encounters.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: “However, they may have become unable to see that side of things.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss. There is something
I must tell you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please, give me permission
to write a message on social media.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san!
There's something I must consult you about!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to mention you in a post on my social media account!
Please take a look and confirm!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait.
I will check with Planet Ngogol.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. Fenomeno, are you still trying to negotiate directly with Gold Ship?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"You could've just written whatever.
...You're way too serious, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We got the green light, Mame-chin.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—!
Thank you so much!!

Fenomeno gathers her thoughts.
Sorting out what she wants to convey,
as the grown-up version of herself now.
—Summer has begun.
